content: Allergic reactions to this medication are uncommon. However, this is not an exhaustive list of potential side effects. In the United States, you should contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. Similarly, in Canada, you should also consult your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before starting ethionamide, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it or if you have any other allergies. This medication may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. Consuming alcohol while on this medication may increase the risk of liver disease or mental/mood changes. Ethionamide may reduce the effectiveness of live bacterial vaccines, such as the typhoid vaccine. If you have diabetes, this medication may lower your blood sugar levels. Regularly monitor your blood sugar as directed and share the results with your doctor. Notify your doctor immediately if you experience symptoms of low blood sugar, such as sudden sweating, shaking, rapid heartbeat, hunger, blurred vision, dizziness, or tingling in your hands or feet. If you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant, inform your doctor. You should not become pregnant while using ethionamide, as it may harm an unborn baby. It is not known whether this medication passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all the products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Laboratory and Medical Tests: While taking this medication, you should undergo regular laboratory and/or medical tests, such as sputum tests, eye/vision exams, liver/thyroid function tests, blood glucose monitoring, and complete blood counts. Ensure you attend all medical and laboratory appointments. Missed Dose: It is crucial to take each dose of this medication as scheduled. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Information: This document provides a summary and does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individual medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
